sections.content: NOT currently hiring for this position. Please submit your resume for future consideration.

We are looking for a courteous, outgoing individual to make and confirm reservations and perform feedback calls by phone. A polite and friendly phone presence is a must. Host responsibilities include learning our computer reservation system (OpenTable), managing reservations, seating guests, answering phone calls, making reservations and light cleaning in the host and surrounding areas. Our host will also show guests how to leave the restaurant and answer questions regarding events, layout of the restaurant and history.

We want to meet you if you enjoy talking to people and thrive in a fast-paced workplace. Your ultimate goal will be to provide high-quality service that will help us maintain and attract customers. Restaurant experience is nice but not required. A friendly, positive attitude is required.
We are looking for night shift positions with some day shifts possible. Please see schedule below.

sections.heading: Responsibilities
sections.content:
Make and confirm reservations
Manage table availability
Manage a wait list (if needed)
Call guests for feedback
Collaborate with other restaurant staff
Deal with complaints or problems with a positive attitude
Seat guests in the appropriate section
Maintain a manageable reservation spread

sections.heading: Skills
sections.content:
Knowing OpenTable reservation system a plus
Attention to cleanliness and safety
Patience and customer-oriented approach
Excellent people skills with a friendly attitude
Responsible and trustworthy
Ability to communicate effectively on the phone and in person
High school diploma is a plus but not required

sections.heading: Schedule:
sections.content: Vernon’s Speakeasy is open from Wednesday - Sunday. We take reservations between 4:00 pm - 8:30 pm. A typical day shift would be from 10:30 am - 3:30 pm. A typical night shift would be from 3:30 pm - 9:00 pm Wednesday - Sunday.
